metadata.source: Bergen & Passaic County Boards of Taxation 2026 Certified Rates

summaryAnalysis.regionalContext: Glen Rock's certified composite tax rate (3.407%) sits in the middle of Bergen County commuter towns, offering top-tier schools with competitive effective millage rates.

comparativeKeyFindings.title: Commercial Ratable Comparison (Paramus vs. Glen Rock)
comparativeKeyFindings.detail: Paramus enjoys massive commercial revenue from 4 major shopping malls, subsidizing its tax rate to 1.745%. In contrast, Glen Rock's tree-lined residential community must fund 90%+ of services from homeowner property taxes.

comparativeKeyFindings.title: Bergen County Commuter Value
comparativeKeyFindings.detail: With two direct NJ Transit rail stations (Main Line & Bergen County Line), Glen Rock provides premier commuter access while maintaining lower average tax bills than neighboring Ridgewood.
